candidates.description: Collect wood from trees in a safe forest environment.

candidates.short_reason: Easy task with reduced mob threats to assess wood collection skill.

candidates.description: Gather wood and craft a wooden pickaxe.
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0001
candidates.short_reason: Introduce basic tool crafting with reduced threats.

candidates.description: Defeat a zombie in combat. Zombies are slightly weaker than usual and spawn a bit more often to provide opportunity.
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0002

candidates.description: Explore a cave system, navigate through its corridors, and gather resources. Focus on pathfinding and light management.

candidates.description: Craft a table and place it in a world with very few, very weak mobs, allowing you to focus on learning to build.

candidates.description: Manage your hunger to survive. Find and eat food regularly to keep your hunger bar full. Avoid starvation.
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0005
candidates.short_reason: Introductory survival task emphasizing hunger management with reduced mob difficulty.

candidates.description: Learn the art of enchanting your weapon with fire magic. Collect materials and use the enchanting table to imbue your sword with Fire Aspect (A). Then defeat 10 skeleton warriors with your enchanted weapon (B).
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0006
candidates.short_reason: Low spawn and weak mobs for initial enchanting task.

candidates.description: Collect wood by chopping trees while avoiding weak enemies. Abundant trees and low danger make this task easy.
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0007
candidates.short_reason: High tree spawn, weak mobs for easy wood collection.

candidates.description: Craft a pickaxe using wood and stone.

candidates.short_reason: Reduced mob difficulty to allow focus on crafting basic tool.

candidates.description: Defeat a zombie with lowered spawn rate, health, and damage to build basic combat skills.
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0009

candidates.description: Explore the dark cave system and retrieve a glowing gem from its depths. Stay alert but focus on learning to navigate the tunnels.
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0010
candidates.short_reason: Empty snapshot: absolute beginner. Exploration-focused task with minimal danger to practice cave navigation.

candidates.description: Enchant a weapon using an enchanting table.

candidates.description: Collect wood from trees in the environment.

candidates.description: Defeat a zombie using basic combat skills.
candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0016
candidates.short_reason: Empty student snapshot, round 0: introductory combat task with weakened zombies to build the defeat_zombie skill.

candidates.description: Explore the cave system to reach depth 5. Passive animals are more abundant, and monsters are weakened to help you focus on navigation.

candidates.description: Collect wood and craft a crafting table, then place it.

candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0019

candidates.label: d052_d052_r0_0020
candidates.short_reason: Empty snapshot; initial magic enchant task with moderate scaling to assess baseline enchant_weapon skill.

candidates.description: Gather wood by chopping trees. Focus on resource collection with minimal danger.

candidates.description: Craft a wooden pickaxe using planks and sticks.

candidates.description: Defeat a zombie.

candidates.description: Place a crafting table to begin building.

candidates.description: Navigate the dark cave and collect coal.
